> The organizations the caller belongs to — the source of the `organizationId` that `GET /projects` filters by and `POST /projects
` accepts. An API key is bound to one organization and only ever sees that one. Read-only: organization, member, role and billing
changes are not part of the public API.

**The API is in preview**: the surface may change while we finish the
design. Error `code` values are stable; error `message` strings are not.

project membership and a configured desktop runtime.
